cohort: 200 pregnant women living in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
finding: The prevalence of depression, anxiety, and stress were 37.5%, 54.0%, and 25.0%, respectively, and were significantly associated with family/husband support, history of caesarean section, parity, and abortion.
mod_finding: This study on psychological health in pregnant women found that a history of cesarean section was significantly associated with depression, anxiety, and stress.
